summary: The closed-publication recovery now retires the verified PR before deriving the replacement intent and CI effect, and the regression covers work, observation and request retirements across repeated replacements.

evidence: src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts now passes retireClosedPublication(proved, now) to createPullRequestFor, so the verified closed PR number is recorded in target.retiredOwnPr before the replacement pull request intent key and pr_open CI effect are built.

tests/repair/loop-closed-existing-head_test.ts adds a regression covering work, observation and request retirement phases, repeated replacements, marker advancement, the after-pr intent key, and a fresh CI ledger reservation carrying publicationAfter distinct from the historical settled row.
The deleted-branch restart path is unchanged because it does not republish the same head and therefore does not need a replacement effect marker.
